sections.h2: Why clapboard should be soft washed
body: Old wood siding doesn't hold up to high pressure. A strong wand can force water up behind the laps, gouge soft grain, and strip paint from trim that only needed cleaning. Many homes around High Springs are clapboard, so pressure washing in High Springs, FL mostly means soft washing. We use low pressure with a cleaning solution that kills mildew and algae at the root and then rinses away cleanly.

High pressure is reserved for surfaces that can take it, like driveways, sidewalks, and concrete pads. Because we're painters, we can tell when chalky or loose paint needs a repaint rather than another cleaning, and we'll say so instead of washing away more of the finish.

body: Prep washing is held to a stricter standard than a cosmetic cleaning. All chalk, pollen, and growth have to come off, and the wood has to dry fully before primer goes on. In High Springs, that can mean waiting a full day or more after washing when the air is humid. If a repaint is next, the wash is built into the High Springs exterior painting scope. If you just want the house clean, we can do that on its own.
Our article on mold on siding explains why growth returns when only the surface layer is removed. For year-round upkeep, see the North Central Florida exterior care guide.

Before a wash, we use eco-conscious cleaning solutions, pre-wet the plants, cover sensitive areas, and control runoff. Afterward, we rinse the landscaping. Downtown storefronts and walkways can be scheduled outside business hours. Decks and fences that will be stained next get a wash suited to bare wood. faqs.q: Is pressure washing safe for old wood siding?
faqs.a: High pressure can damage it. We soft wash clapboard and painted trim with low pressure and a cleaning solution, and save high pressure for concrete.

faqs.q: How do you clean algae off a porch ceiling?
faqs.a: We use a low-pressure soft wash that treats the growth at the root, then rinse. Porch ceilings are a common spot for regrowth, so a mildew-resistant finish helps if the ceiling is being painted afterward.

faqs.q: Can you wash my house without painting it?
faqs.a: Yes. Washing is available as a stand-alone service, and it's also included as the first step in any exterior repaint.
Yes. Commercial fronts and walkways can be washed early in the morning or after closing so customers aren't affected.
